title_en: Regulations on the Administration of Controlled Chemicals of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: These Regulations are formulated to strengthen the management of controlled chemicals, safeguard the personal safety of citizens and protect the environment.
Any person engaged in the production, operation and use of controlled chemicals within the territory of the People's Republic of China shall comply with these Regulations.

The competent chemical industry department of the State Council shall be responsible for the administration of controlled chemicals throughout the country. The competent chemical industry departments of the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall be responsible for the administration of controlled chemicals within their respective administrative regions.

Any person who produces, operates or uses controlled chemicals shall, in accordance with these Regulations and the relevant provisions of the State, declare to the competent chemical industry department of the State Council or the competent chemical industry department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government the relevant materials, data and purposes of use concerning the production, operation or use of controlled chemicals, and shall accept the inspection and supervision of the competent chemical industry department.

The State shall strictly control the production of Category 1 controlled chemicals.
Where it is necessary to produce Category 1 controlled chemicals for the purposes of scientific research, medical treatment, manufacture of medicines or protection, an application shall be submitted to the competent chemical industry department of the State Council for approval, and the production shall be carried out in small-scale facilities designated by the competent chemical industry department of the State Council.
It is strictly prohibited to produce Category 1 controlled chemicals in facilities not designated by the competent chemical industry department of the State Council.

The State shall implement a special permit system for the production of Category 2 and Category 3 controlled chemicals and the specific organic chemicals containing phosphorus, sulfur or fluorine under Category 4 controlled chemicals; without a special permit, no unit or individual may produce such chemicals. The measures for the special permit shall be formulated by the competent chemical industry department of the State Council.

Any unit that intends to construct, expand or renovate facilities for producing Category 2 and Category 3 controlled chemicals and the specific organic chemicals containing phosphorus, sulfur or fluorine under Category 4 controlled chemicals shall submit an application to the competent chemical industry department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government where the unit is located. After examination and signing of comments by the competent chemical industry department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government, and upon approval by the competent chemical industry department of the State Council, the construction may commence; after completion of the project, upon acceptance inspection by the competent chemical industry department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government and approval by the competent chemical industry department of the State Council, the facilities may be put into operation.
Any unit that intends to construct, expand or renovate facilities for producing specific organic chemicals not containing phosphorus, sulfur or fluorine under Category 4 controlled chemicals shall, before commencing production, file a record with the competent chemical industry department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government where the unit is located.

Controlled chemicals shall be stored in dedicated chemical warehouses and shall be managed by specially assigned personnel. The storage conditions of controlled chemicals shall comply with the relevant provisions of the State.

Units storing controlled chemicals shall establish strict inspection and registration systems for the receipt and delivery of such chemicals. In case of loss or theft, they shall immediately report to the local public security organ and the competent chemical industry department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government where the unit is located; the competent chemical industry department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government shall actively cooperate with the public security organ in the investigation and handling of the case.

Article 11 Monitoring chemicals that have deteriorated or become expired or ineffective shall be promptly disposed. The disposal plan shall be submitted to the competent department of chemical industry of the people's government of the relevant province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government for approval before implementation.

Article 12 Where it is necessary to use Category I monitoring chemicals for the purposes of scientific research, medical treatment, drug manufacturing, or protection, an application shall be submitted to the competent department of chemical industry under the State Council. Upon examination and approval by the competent department of chemical industry under the State Council, a contract shall be signed, on the strength of the approval document, with the production unit designated by the competent department of chemical industry under the State Council, and a duplicate of the contract shall be submitted to the competent department of chemical industry under the State Council for recordation.

Article 13 Where it is necessary to use Category II monitoring chemicals, an application shall be submitted to the competent department of chemical industry of the people's government of the relevant province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government. Upon examination and approval by the competent department of chemical industry of the people's government of the relevant province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government, a contract shall be signed, on the strength of the approval document, with the distribution unit designated by the competent department of chemical industry under the State Council, and a duplicate of the contract shall be submitted to the competent department of chemical industry of the people's government of the relevant province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government for recordation.

Article 14 The units designated by the competent department of chemical industry under the State Council jointly with the competent department of foreign trade and economic cooperation under the State Council (hereinafter referred to as the designated units) may engage in the import and export of Category I monitoring chemicals and Category II and Category III monitoring chemicals and their production technologies and special equipment.
Where it is necessary to import or export Category I monitoring chemicals and Category II and Category III monitoring chemicals and their production technologies and special equipment, the designated unit shall be entrusted to handle the import or export on behalf of the applicant. No unit or individual other than the designated units may engage in such import and export business.

Article 15 The State strictly controls the import and export of Category I monitoring chemicals. Unless for the purposes of scientific research, medical treatment, drug manufacturing, or protection, Category I monitoring chemicals shall not be imported.
A designated unit that is entrusted to import Category I monitoring chemicals shall submit an application to the competent department of chemical industry under the State Council, together with a description and certification of the ultimate use of the products; after examination and endorsement by the competent department of chemical industry under the State Council, the application shall be submitted to the State Council for examination and approval. The designated unit shall, on the strength of the approval document of the State Council, apply to the competent department of foreign trade and economic cooperation under the State Council for an import license.

Article 16 A designated unit that is entrusted to import Category II and Category III monitoring chemicals and their production technologies and special equipment shall submit an application to the competent department of chemical industry under the State Council, together with a description and certification of the ultimate use of the imported chemicals, production technologies, or special equipment; after examination and approval by the competent department of chemical industry under the State Council, the designated unit shall, on the strength of the approval document of the competent department of chemical industry under the State Council, apply to the competent department of foreign trade and economic cooperation under the State Council for an import license.

Article 17 A designated unit that is entrusted to export Category I monitoring chemicals shall submit an application to the competent department of chemical industry under the State Council, together with a letter of guarantee issued by the government of the importing country or an institution authorized by such government, certifying that the imported chemicals are only for the purposes of scientific research, medical treatment, drug manufacturing, or protection and shall not be re-exported to a third country; after examination and endorsement by the competent department of chemical industry under the State Council, the application shall be submitted to the State Council for examination and approval. The designated unit shall, on the strength of the approval document of the State Council, apply to the competent department of foreign trade and economic cooperation under the State Council for an export license.

Article 18 A designated unit that is entrusted to export Category II and Category III monitoring chemicals and their production technologies and special equipment shall submit an application to the competent department of chemical industry under the State Council, together with a letter of guarantee issued by the government of the importing country or an institution authorized by such government, certifying that the imported chemicals, production technologies, or special equipment shall not be used for the production of chemical weapons and shall not be re-exported to a third country; after examination and approval by the competent department of chemical industry under the State Council, the designated unit shall, on the strength of the approval document of the competent department of chemical industry under the State Council, apply to the competent department of foreign trade and economic cooperation under the State Council for an export license.

Article 19 The use of monitoring chemicals shall be consistent with the declared purpose of use; if the purpose of use needs to be changed, it shall be reported to the original approving authority for approval.

Article 20 Where Category I and Category II monitoring chemicals are used, the quantity of such monitoring chemicals consumed and the quantity of final products produced using such monitoring chemicals shall be reported periodically to the competent department of chemical industry of the people's government of the relevant province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government in accordance with the relevant provisions of the State.

Article 21 Anyone who produces monitored chemicals in violation of these Regulations shall be ordered by the competent chemical industry department of the people's government of a province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government to make corrections within a specified time limit. If no correction is made within that time limit, a fine of not more than 200,000 yuan may be imposed. If the circumstances are serious, the said department may propose that the people's government of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government order the suspension of production for rectification.

Article 22 Anyone who uses monitored chemicals in violation of these Regulations shall be ordered by the competent chemical industry department of the people's government of a province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government to make corrections within a specified time limit. If no correction is made within that time limit, a fine of not more than 50,000 yuan may be imposed.

Article 23 Anyone who trades in monitored chemicals in violation of these Regulations shall be subject to confiscation of the illegally traded monitored chemicals and illegal income by the competent chemical industry department of the people's government of a province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government, and may concurrently be imposed a fine of not less than one time but not more than two times the illegal turnover.

Article 24 Anyone who, in violation of these Regulations, conceals or refuses to report materials or data concerning monitored chemicals, or obstructs or hinders the competent chemical industry department from performing its duties of inspection and supervision in accordance with these Regulations, shall be imposed a fine of not more than 50,000 yuan by the competent chemical industry department of the people's government of a province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government.

Article 25 Anyone who, in violation of these Regulations, commits an act that constitutes a violation of public security administration shall be punished in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Penalties for Administration of Public Security; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 26 Any person who has already engaged in the production, trade, or use of monitored chemicals before these Regulations come into force shall go through the relevant procedures in accordance with the provisions of these Regulations.
Article 27 These Regulations shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
